title: The Sam Morgan band and its later roughness
summary: Sam and Isaiah Morgan's trumpets, the original personnel, and how the band got rougher when Isaiah took over.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Sam wasn't rough then. His band was smooth. Real smooth. When was that? That was the old Sam Morgan band before?

Izel. Oh, Izel took it there. Before Izel took it. Oh, you see Izel was playing second trumpet, what they called second trumpet, but in their band Sam and Izel made the same thing. It was great. Two great men to make the same thing at the same time. I never could understand. It was great. It wasn't a very seldom any second was made. Mike, they would make the same thing at the same time. It sounded good, huh? I mean, it sounded like one, but so heavy, you know.
The Young Morgan with Sam added on or was it the old original Morgan band?
The Young Morgan band was the roughest after Sam got out of the picture, he got sick and when Isaiah took it over and then they began to get rough.
Well who was in that original band?
The Young Morgan, George E. Parker, Johnny Devers playing the banjo and his bass player used to play with Celestine. Little Jim, he played with him. Jim Crow played trombone with him.
That's the Young guys, that's the young brothers. The Young Brothers.
No that's the band of Sam Morgan. And they had Nolan Williams playing drum. That's the old band. Well practically it's a saxophone player, I can't think of his name to play with him.

Pouché, that's it. He's the one. Well practically the band was almost the same. After Sam got out of it for a while and then Isaiah began to get younger fellas like Albert ! He was playing first trumpet and Isaiah Morgan playing second. Well that's the time they began to get rough. And Cleo on bass, you heard talk of him? Oh yeah. Yeah, well guys like him, great young bitch, I mean come up, I mean after Jim you know.
I never did know his full name Cleo.
Well it was just, I can't think of it, I know it, but I can't think of it.
